title: lessons-extractor configuration
description: Configuration schema for the lessons-extractor skill

logGlob.description: Base directory for Claude Code log files (user home scoped)

redactPatterns.description: Regex patterns for sensitive data to redact before processing

outputDir.description: Directory for output files (relative to project root)

preprocessor.description: Preprocessor-specific settings for efficient log processing

maxLogsPerRun.description: Maximum log files to process per run

maxBytesPerLog.description: Maximum bytes to read from each log file

maxEventsPerLog.description: Maximum events to extract per log file

truncateContentLength.description: Maximum length for content fields before truncation

contextEventsCount.description: Number of events to keep from session start for context

resolutionEventsCount.description: Number of events to keep from session end for resolution

errorWindowEvents.description: Events before/after each error to include

skipExtractorSessions.description: Skip sessions that are running lessons-extractor

maxRecentFiles.description: Maximum files to track in cursor for incremental runs

maxOutputSizeBytes.description: Maximum output file size in bytes

followSymlinks.description: Follow symbolic links when discovering logs
